metadata.title: Build an AI Daily Briefing with n8n
metadata.description: Build a self-hosted workflow that retrieves, ranks, summarizes, and emails the most important AI and technology news each day.

outcomes: Deploy a persistent n8n instance with Docker Compose on Ubuntu.
Retrieve and normalize current AI news with Tavily Search.
Filter, deduplicate, rank, and batch articles for AI processing.
Generate validated structured summaries with Gemini.
Render and deliver an HTML briefing through Gmail on a daily schedule.
requirements: 2 vCPUs, 4 GB memory, and 20 GB storage
Tavily, Google AI Studio, and Google Cloud accounts

modules.title: Configure the Runtime Environment
modules.description: Prepare Ubuntu, verify connectivity, install Docker, and run a persistent n8n service.

lessons.title: Verify the Virtual Machine Environment
objectives: Confirm the Ubuntu version and processor architecture.
Check CPU, memory, storage, time synchronization, and sudo access.

activity.prompt: Run the environment checks and record whether the machine meets every minimum requirement.

lessons.title: Verify the Network Environment
objectives: Check the network interface, default route, and DNS resolution.
Verify HTTPS access to every service required by the course.

activity.prompt: Test all required service domains and diagnose any request that returns HTTP status 000.

lessons.title: Install Docker
objectives: Configure Docker's official Ubuntu repository and signing key.
Install Docker Engine and verify the service with a test container.

activity.prompt: Install Docker and run the official hello-world container successfully.

lessons.title: Install and Start n8n
objectives: Create a persistent Docker volume and Compose configuration for n8n.
Start n8n 2.31.7 and complete the local account setup.

activity.prompt: Open n8n at localhost:5678 and verify that workflows survive a container restart.

modules.title: Build the AI Daily Briefing Workflow
modules.description: Build, test, and schedule the complete news-to-email automation in n8n.

lessons.title: Create the Workflow and Add a Trigger
objectives: Identify the main areas of the n8n workflow editor.
Add and test a Manual Trigger before enabling automation.

activity.prompt: Execute the Manual Trigger and confirm that the node reports success.

lessons.title: Retrieve News with Tavily
objectives: Create and securely configure a Tavily credential in n8n.
Retrieve recent AI and technology news with a Tavily node.

activity.prompt: Run the Tavily node and confirm that it returns a non-empty results array.

lessons.title: Organize the News Data
objectives: Split Tavily's results array into individual n8n items.
Normalize article fields for later processing.

activity.prompt: Inspect the output and confirm that every item exposes the normalized article fields.

lessons.title: Clean, Deduplicate, Sort, and Limit Articles
objectives: Remove incomplete, duplicate, and previously processed articles.
Sort candidates by relevance and aggregate them for Gemini.

activity.prompt: Run the processing chain twice and confirm that invalid and previously handled articles are excluded.

lessons.title: Generate Structured Summaries with Gemini
objectives: Call the Gemini generateContent endpoint from n8n.
Constrain the model to return ranked, categorized JSON results.

activity.prompt: Execute the Gemini request and verify that the response finishes normally and contains parseable JSON.

lessons.title: Parse the Response and Generate the Briefing
objectives: Validate and clean Gemini's structured response in an n8n Code node.
Generate a complete email subject and responsive HTML briefing.

activity.prompt: Run the Code node and preview both the generated subject and HTML output.

lessons.title: Send the Email and Schedule Daily Execution
objectives: Configure Gmail OAuth with the minimum send scope.
Send a test briefing and enable a daily Schedule Trigger.

activity.prompt: Deliver a complete test briefing, enable the daily schedule, and confirm the workflow is active.
